methods.label: Nonnegative terms and triangle angles
methods.explanation: If the sum of two nonnegative numbers is 0, both must be 0. Thus, \(\sin A=1/2\) gives \(\angle A=30^\circ\), and \(\tan B=1\) gives \(\angle B=45^\circ\). Therefore, \(\angle C=180^\circ-30^\circ-45^\circ=105^\circ\).
